objective:
server/services/documents/text.ts markdown extraction: the setext-heading branch only fires when the paragraph buffer is empty, so textToBlocks('Line A
Line B
---

Body', true) yields PARAGRAPH 'Line A Line B ---' instead of a HEADING 'Line A Line B'; and a standalone '---' / '***' / '___' after a blank line becomes a PARAGRAPH block. HEADING blocks drive capability-kernel section units (CLAUDE.md §37). Fix: when an underline follows a non-empty paragraph, emit the buffered text as a HEADING ('=' any length, '-' at least 2); treat a standalone thematic break as a flush and drop it.
expectedOutcome: Multi-line setext headings become HEADING blocks and thematic breaks produce no text.

acceptanceConditions.statement: setext headings after multi-line paragraphs are headings and thematic breaks produce no blocks, with a test that fails before the fix
